REALITY_AND_REALISM.problem_genesis: The problem of reality hardens when access, causal resistance, existence and objectivity are compressed into a single demand for mind-independent presence.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.deconflation: Separate Realität, Wirklichkeit, existence, causal resistance, perspective-stability and correction-source; none alone is the whole meaning of the real.

genealogies.lexical: realitas, Realität and Wirklichkeit carry different histories of thinghood, effectiveness and actuality; translation can erase the difference before argument begins.
genealogies.conceptual: The function of securing an independent object migrates from substance to resistance, lawfulness, accessibility and later to world-disclosure without simply disappearing.
genealogies.problem: The question changes from what is real, to how consciousness reaches it, to how a world lets anything count as a being, and finally to which constraints survive changes of access.

REALITY_AND_REALISM.counter_genealogy: A non-Heideggerian line can begin from error, experiment and cross-perspectival invariance: reality need not be a hidden substance, but neither need it be exhausted by disclosure.
rivals: Critical realism: access is mediated, while causal and nomological constraints are not produced by that mediation.
Correlation-first pluralism: the real is articulated only within practices, but practices encounter heterogeneous constraints that cannot be freely redescribed.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.positive_kernel: Realism survives most strongly as a mode-indexed asymmetry: conditions of access and conditions of existence can interact without becoming identical, and the source of correction varies by kind of being.

formal_indication.name: Constraint-sensitive reality
formal_indication.direction: Look for what corrects a practice across changes of perspective, instrument and vocabulary.
formal_indication.negation: Do not infer either hidden substance or construction merely from mediation.
formal_indication.enactment: Vary the access regime and compare which dependencies, errors and invariants remain.
formal_indication.limit: No single correction signature is promised for stones, pains, money, organisms or mathematical objects.

REALITY_AND_REALISM.surprise: The deepest realism in the dossier may lie not in an answer to 'what is real?' but in an ontology of heterogeneous correction: different beings can resist us in categorically different ways.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.self_critique: A profile ecology may become a polite name for unlimited pluralism; unless profiles share discriminators, every counterexample can be quarantined as another mode.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.mutation: Treat modes as revisable hypotheses constrained by contrast cases, not as a taxonomy guaranteed in advance.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.destroyed: The binary in which the real is either absolutely independent or merely constituted for access.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.preserved: The realist demand that error and correction cannot circulate only inside the interpreting practice.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.open: Whether one cross-regional notion of constraint connects physical, phenomenal, social and ideal cases without flattening them.
REALITY_AND_REALISM.revision_trigger: Reopen the analysis if a proposed realization profile cannot distinguish a genuine external correction from an internally generated failure score.

ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.problem_genesis: The modern problem of consciousness is partly produced when act, immanent content and transcendent object are placed inside one container and then asked to recover an outside.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.deconflation: Separate the occurrence of an act, what is presented or meant, the identity-pole across presentations, prereflective givenness and later reflective thematization.

genealogies.lexical: Bewusstsein, Erlebnis, Inhalt, Gegenstand and intentionality do not form a stable multilingual synonym set.
genealogies.conceptual: Functions once assigned to consciousness migrate toward intentionality, Dasein, worldhood, temporality and practice, while phenomenal character can fall through the transfer.
genealogies.problem: The problem shifts from an inner image matching an outer thing to the constitution of object-identity and then to how a shared world makes correctness and error possible.

ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.counter_genealogy: A Husserlian counterline preserves act–content–object distinctions and founded reflection without reducing the object to a real part of consciousness or dissolving experience into world-structure.
rivals: Intentional correlation: objectivity is constituted through manifolds of givenness while the object is not a mental component.
Enactive world-involvement: object and act are stabilized in embodied practices, with phenomenal character retained as a non-substitutable dimension.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.positive_kernel: The object is neither an inner content nor a bare remainder outside the act; it is a corrigible identity-pole whose modes of givenness can vary while still constraining recognition.

formal_indication.name: Corrigible identity-pole
formal_indication.direction: Track recurrence, mismatch and correction across changing acts.
formal_indication.negation: Do not equate what is experienced with the act of experiencing or the object experienced.
formal_indication.enactment: Compare perception, memory, error and reflection for transformations of the same candidate object.
formal_indication.limit: The formula does not decide whether the pole is ideal, physical, social or processual.

ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.surprise: Reflection may not simply disclose a pre-existing act; it can alter the very phenomenon offered as evidence, so reflexive certainty is also an intervention.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.self_critique: Multiplying dimensions can conceal their dependence and leave no account of why they belong to one experience.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.mutation: Require every distinction to state the synthesis or coupling that lets it participate in one episode without becoming identical to the others.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.destroyed: The container picture in which act, content and object occupy one homogeneous interior domain.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.preserved: First-person givenness and intentional objectivity as irreducible but correlated phenomena.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.open: What unifies phenomenal presence, intentional directedness and worldly correction without installing a new transcendental bearer.
ACT_CONTENT_OBJECT.revision_trigger: Reopen if a rival model explains error and object persistence while showing that the proposed identity-pole adds no discriminating work.

REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.problem_genesis: A universal ontology is produced too early when cases are counted as beings before their origin, maintenance, identity, access and correction relations are distinguished.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.deconflation: Separate existence, coming-to-be, continued maintenance, individuation, persistence, accessibility, dependence and normative recognition for every case.

genealogies.lexical: Words for being, reality, existence and realization repeatedly exchange roles across scholastic, phenomenological and ordinary registers.
genealogies.conceptual: Substance, constitution, practice, process and constraint successively inherit the task of saying what makes something the entity it is.
genealogies.problem: The search for one criterion of reality becomes a comparative question: which relations are constitutive, causal, epistemic or normative for this kind of entity?

REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.counter_genealogy: A sparse realism can refuse profiles and retain a shared existence predicate, treating regional differences as differences among entities rather than modes of being.
rivals: Ontological pluralism: distinct domains instantiate irreducibly different dependence and identity structures.
Deflationary realism: one thin existence notion is shared, while profiles describe explanatory practices rather than modes of being.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.positive_kernel: The strongest contribution is not seven examples proving one ontology, but a comparative apparatus that makes premature cross-domain promotion visible.

formal_indication.name: Regional realization profile
formal_indication.direction: Ask separately how an entity originates, persists, is accessed, is corrected and is counted as one.
formal_indication.negation: Do not let one dependence relation stand for every ontological question.
formal_indication.enactment: Run the same profile across heterogeneous and boundary cases, then look for real convergences.
formal_indication.limit: A profile is an investigative grid, not proof that reality itself is partitioned in exactly this way.

REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.surprise: The project's regionalism implies that ontological counting precedes ontology: before comparing modes of being, the analyst must justify why each apparent case is one case at all.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.self_critique: The six-dimensional grid can preformat every phenomenon and mistake the protocol's columns for structures of reality.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.mutation: Allow dimensions to merge, split or disappear when a case resists them; record such resistance as a revision of the instrument.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.destroyed: Automatic promotion from one successful regional criterion to a universal structure of all beings.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.preserved: A disciplined comparison of heterogeneous cases and the asymmetry between existence and accessibility.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.open: Whether the profiles reveal ontological plurality or only the plurality of explanatory interests.
REGIONAL_REALIZATION_PROFILE.revision_trigger: Reopen when a case repeatedly requires a relation absent from the grid or renders two dimensions systematically indistinguishable.

DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.problem_genesis: A developmental narrative appears necessary when recurring terms are treated as stable carriers and later concepts are read as solutions already latent in early texts.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.deconflation: Separate lexical recurrence, conceptual continuity, problem continuity, functional succession, reversal, political displacement and retrospective self-interpretation.

genealogies.lexical: The same word can change function between works, while one function can migrate across entirely different words.
genealogies.conceptual: Reality, world, being, difference, Lichtung, Ereignis and technology may inherit burdens from one another without forming a single continuous doctrine.
genealogies.problem: Different works may answer different problem-scenes; a later solution cannot be credited with solving an earlier question until the bridge is reconstructed.

DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.counter_genealogy: Instead of one road from the early to the late Heidegger, construct several local trajectories, abandoned paths and reversals, including politically contaminated and self-corrective lines.
rivals: Continuity thesis: a stable question of being organizes terminological change as successive reformulation.
Discontinuous constellation thesis: local problems and historical interventions overlap without one governing trajectory.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.positive_kernel: Diachrony is most defensible as a graph of functionally specified local bridges, not a biography-shaped line from immature to mature thought.

formal_indication.name: Diachronic function graph
formal_indication.direction: Index every recurrence by date, problem-scene, argumentative load and discarded alternatives.
formal_indication.negation: Do not infer conceptual identity from lexical identity or telos from chronology.
formal_indication.enactment: Seek explicit transitions, changed opponents, counterexamples and later reversals across independently fixed texts.
formal_indication.limit: The graph does not deny all unity; it makes unity an achievement requiring bridges.

DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.surprise: The most philosophically decisive development may be a reversal rather than a culmination: GA 40's followerless leading can function as an internal critique of the follower-producing rhetoric of 1933.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.self_critique: A graph can merely hide narrative choices in edge selection and create an illusion of neutrality.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.mutation: Every diachronic edge must carry both a continuity case and a discontinuity case; neither is the default.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.destroyed: Retrospective smoothing in which later vocabulary supplies the meaning of earlier passages.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.preserved: The possibility of real transformations and functional inheritances across the corpus.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.open: Whether a sufficiently strong invariant connects local trajectories without becoming the very total narrative under criticism.
DIACHRONIC_HEIDEGGER.revision_trigger: Reopen when an independently dated passage reverses the assigned function of a recurring term or supplies a rival transition path.

TERM_GENEALOGY.problem_genesis: A term genealogy becomes seductive when a sequence of words is made to carry an already decided philosophical development.
TERM_GENEALOGY.deconflation: Separate word history, concept history, translation history, problem history, cited predecessors and the analyst's retrospective series.

genealogies.lexical: realitas, Realität, Wirklichkeit, Existenz and Sein have intersecting but non-identical semantic careers.
genealogies.conceptual: The work of securing actuality, independence, existence and intelligibility can migrate independently of those words.
genealogies.problem: Questions about what exists, what acts, what appears and what makes beings intelligible need not share one origin.

TERM_GENEALOGY.counter_genealogy: Build a genealogy from excluded synonyms, translation failures and cases where the same philosophical function appears under another word.
rivals: Lexical continuity: changes in the term family reveal a coherent transformation of the reality problem.
Problem-scene pluralism: the apparent family is a retrospective bundle of several only partially connected debates.
TERM_GENEALOGY.positive_kernel: A rigorous genealogy is a braid of lexical, conceptual and problem lines whose convergences and separations are themselves results.

formal_indication.name: Genealogical braid
formal_indication.direction: Follow words, functions and questions on separate tracks before connecting them.
formal_indication.negation: Neither etymology nor chronological succession proves philosophical inheritance.
formal_indication.enactment: Test every proposed link against a functional successor and an independently plausible counterline.
formal_indication.limit: A braid maps transformations; it does not establish causal influence without source evidence.

TERM_GENEALOGY.surprise: A disappeared word may be more genealogically active than a repeated one when its argumentative function has migrated into a new conceptual center.
TERM_GENEALOGY.self_critique: The braid metaphor can permit arbitrary connections unless each crossing has a dated and discriminating basis.
TERM_GENEALOGY.mutation: Treat missing links and broken inheritances as first-class nodes rather than gaps to be filled narratively.
TERM_GENEALOGY.destroyed: The equation word history = concept history = problem history.
TERM_GENEALOGY.preserved: Genealogy as a way to reveal contingent inheritances and forgotten alternatives.
TERM_GENEALOGY.open: Which transitions are historical dependencies and which are only functional analogies.
TERM_GENEALOGY.revision_trigger: Reopen when a primary occurrence shows that two terms assigned one function operate differently in their local arguments.

META_CRITIQUE.problem_genesis: The method becomes self-sealing when every objection is redescribed as further evidence that another layer of destruction is needed.
META_CRITIQUE.deconflation: Separate recursive revisability, endless suspicion, preference for difference, preference for origins, openness and actual correction by resistant material.

genealogies.lexical: Destruktion, Abbau, reduction, construction, repetition and critique name overlapping but not identical methodological gestures.
genealogies.conceptual: The method inherits both phenomenological return and genealogical suspicion, which can pull in opposite directions.
genealogies.problem: The need to reopen hardened concepts can mutate into a demand that no articulation ever be allowed to stabilize.

META_CRITIQUE.counter_genealogy: A constructive counterline treats stable definitions, formalization and closure as locally enabling achievements rather than symptoms to dismantle by default.
rivals: Recursive fallibilism: every result remains reopenable but can provisionally guide inquiry.
Methodological quietism: stop once local explanatory and textual burdens are met; further meta-critique often adds no phenomenon.
META_CRITIQUE.positive_kernel: Destruktion remains alive only if resistant counterexamples can change its operators, not merely add cautions to their output.

formal_indication.name: Revisable operation ecology
formal_indication.direction: Look for where the material changes the method's own distinctions and priorities.
formal_indication.negation: Do not equate recursion with rigor or openness with truth.
formal_indication.enactment: Record operator conflicts, retire redundant tests and mutate a positive kernel after self-critique.
formal_indication.limit: Some stable procedures remain necessary for provenance, safety and comparison.

META_CRITIQUE.surprise: The method's deepest metaphysical commitment may be its belief that richer differentiation is usually truer than closure.
META_CRITIQUE.self_critique: Even sufficient openness can become a ritual endpoint if every analysis is forced to contain the same kinds of openness.
META_CRITIQUE.mutation: Define openness structurally but let its content and path differ; permit an analysis to retire an operator when the phenomenon makes it redundant.
META_CRITIQUE.destroyed: Methodological immunity and the automatic prestige of ever-deeper recursion.
META_CRITIQUE.preserved: Versioned self-correction, explicit residuals and the right of material to alter the protocol.
META_CRITIQUE.open: How to distinguish productive reopening from indecision and compulsive meta-analysis.
META_CRITIQUE.revision_trigger: Reopen the engine itself when distinct corpora repeatedly produce the same graph regardless of their questions.

MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.problem_genesis: A derivative representation becomes philosophically dangerous not simply when it is false, but when its local success hides the promotion from access or orientation to understanding and adjudication.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.deconflation: Separate access, navigation, orientation, evidence localization, argument reconstruction, interpretation and adjudication; distinguish editorial order from authorial architecture and accuracy from sufficiency.

genealogies.lexical: Overview, Gesamtbild, Brevier, selection, summary, registry and analytics name different compressive roles that are easily homogenized as mere representation.
genealogies.conceptual: Compression migrates from pedagogical selection to editorial architecture, scholarly registry and automated synthesis while retaining an unresolved gain-risk pair: salience gain ↔ closure risk.
genealogies.problem: The question moves from whether popularization distorts to which epistemic role a representation may perform and whether a reader can reconstruct the alternatives and losses hidden by its success.

MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.counter_genealogy: A counterline begins from productive loss: selective omission can increase structural salience, so completeness is not the universal measure and return to the raw original is not automatically better for every task.
rivals: Source maximalism: only extensive return to primary context can support philosophical understanding and judgment.
Role-bounded mediation: substantial compression is legitimate for navigation and orientation, while higher-burden claims require progressively richer context and reversible traceback.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.positive_kernel: Compression is legitimate only relative to an explicit epistemic role; as claim burden rises, permitted loss falls and the route from synthesis to constituent claims, evidence spans and excluded context must remain reconstructable.

formal_indication.name: Role-Bounded Compression
formal_indication.direction: Ask what epistemic work this representation is licensed to perform before judging its adequacy.
formal_indication.negation: Do not promote overview accuracy into understanding sufficiency or editorial sequence into authorial system.
formal_indication.enactment: Attempt to reconstruct the source argument, omitted context, rival unitizations and collapsed ambiguities from the analytic representation.
formal_indication.limit: Reconstructability is necessary for high-burden use but does not itself amount to understanding or truth.

MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.surprise: The automation engine can become a Laienbrevier of its own corpus: the more elegant and useful its Gesamtbild, the easier it is to forget that the result is a derivative selection.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.self_critique: A traceback ledger can create a new illusion of mastery: formal links may remain intact while phenomenological enactment, argumentative force and excluded alternatives are still lost.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.mutation: Emit a loss account and at least one rival unitization with every high-burden synthesis; treat inability to reverse the compression as a research branch rather than as a hidden confidence penalty.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.destroyed: The equations accurate overview = adequate understanding and provenance = reconstructability.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.preserved: Selective loss as a legitimate source of salience, accessibility and first orientation.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.open: Which dimensions of philosophical understanding cannot be recovered by a formally complete traceback and require renewed encounter with the source's enactment.
MEDIATION_COMPRESSION.revision_trigger: Reopen if a compressed representation repeatedly supports independent high-burden adjudication without losing relevant distinctions, or if full traceback fails to improve reconstruction.

TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.problem_genesis: A total technological epoch is produced when technical artifact, calculability, ordering, resource-status and planetary uniformity are read as one uninterrupted phenomenon.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.deconflation: Separate tool use, engineering, availability, measurement, optimization, standing-reserve, human resourceization, institutional ordering and ontological totalization; do not erase the GA 7/GA 79 tension over whether humans themselves are Bestand.

genealogies.lexical: Machenschaft, Technik, Gestell and Bestand are not interchangeable stages of one definition.
genealogies.conceptual: The critique shifts from makeability and power to ordering, permanent readiness, information and cybernetic control.
genealogies.problem: The question changes from what technology is to how practices render heterogeneous beings operationally legible and reorderable.

TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.counter_genealogy: Histories of multistability, repair, situated design and resistant infrastructures show technical practices that cannot be reduced to one ordering logic.
rivals: Epochal Gestell: modern technology is governed by a dominant disclosure of beings as standing-reserve.
Plural technical regimes: ordering is one recurrent operational pattern among contested designs, uses and counterpractices.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.positive_kernel: Gestell is strongest as a discriminating operational signature—continuous availability, reorderability, substitutability and externalized objectives—not as an automatic label for every modern artifact.

formal_indication.name: Ordering signature
formal_indication.direction: Inspect how a system makes entities available, comparable, replaceable and callable on demand.
formal_indication.negation: Do not infer a total epoch from technical novelty or use alone.
formal_indication.enactment: Compare breakdowns, counterpractices, multistable uses and cases that resist optimization.
formal_indication.limit: Operational signatures may coexist and conflict within one technical assemblage.

TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.surprise: Opacity is not the opposite of technological ordering: a system can render behaviour calculable and controllable while its internal process becomes less intelligible.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.self_critique: An operational signature can domesticate Heidegger's ontological challenge into a neutral audit checklist.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.mutation: Retain the question of disclosure as a change in what can count and matter, but require concrete operational pathways, human-resourceization counterevidence and corrigible design or governance alternatives for every totalizing claim.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.destroyed: The inference technical object → Gestell → total epoch.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.preserved: The insight that technology organizes modes of availability and can transform entities, humans included, into reorderable stock.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.open: When a distributed set of ordering practices becomes a historically dominant disclosure regime rather than a regional tendency.
TECHNOLOGY_AND_ORDERING.revision_trigger: Reopen if a purported Gestell case lacks continuous readiness, reorderability or substitutability, or if a counterpractice changes the mode without abandoning technology.

IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.problem_genesis: Identity questions are often asked after the analyst has silently decided what counts as one bearer and which temporal or social boundary matters.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.deconflation: Separate identification, numerical identity, qualitative similarity, persistence, sortal continuity, lineage, token/type and prior individuation.

genealogies.lexical: Identität, Selbigkeit, Einheit, Wiedererkennbarkeit and Individuation distribute several questions that translation can compress.
genealogies.conceptual: Identity shifts from substance and continuity of matter to synthesis, criteria, process, narrative, functional state and institutional lineage.
genealogies.problem: The prior question is not only whether X remains the same, but which partition makes X one candidate at all.

IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.counter_genealogy: A strict sortal or substance account can challenge scale-sensitive pluralism by demanding non-interest-relative truth conditions for counting and persistence.
rivals: Sortal essentialism: a kind supplies principled identity and persistence conditions.
Constraint-indexed process pluralism: units emerge from domain-specific integration and may nest or overlap.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.positive_kernel: Ontological counting precedes identity: boundaries must be justified by discriminating constraints and counter-partitions before persistence can be assessed.

formal_indication.name: Constraint-indexed unit
formal_indication.direction: Ask what integrates this candidate more strongly than its environment at a stated scale.
formal_indication.negation: Do not confuse recognition, classification or product naming with individuation.
formal_indication.enactment: Compare rival partitions under intervention, breakdown, lineage change, fission and scale shift.
formal_indication.limit: Scale sensitivity does not make every partition equally good or merely subjective.

IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.surprise: Fission cases show that ancestry may preserve lineage without preserving numerical identity; continuity can survive precisely by becoming plural.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.self_critique: Constraint-indexing risks process absolutism or an ontology that multiplies individuals whenever an explanatory interest changes.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.mutation: Admit nested units only when independent breakdown or intervention patterns support their boundaries, and record unresolved overlap rather than forcing one count.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.destroyed: Ready-made units, spatial boundary as universal criterion and recognition as identity-maker.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.preserved: Objective constraints on counting, regional criteria and the possibility of nested or distributed individuality.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.open: Whether a domain-general relation connects boundary and integration without becoming the next universal foundation.
IDENTITY_AND_INDIVIDUATION.revision_trigger: Reopen if the preferred partition has no discriminator against a plausible counter-partition or changes only with the analyst's vocabulary.

default.problem_genesis: The question appears unavoidable because several distinguishable operations have been compressed into one inherited conceptual necessity.
default.deconflation: Separate the relata, relation types, scales, modes of access and practical functions presupposed by the question.

genealogies.lexical: Track the word's translations and changes of use without treating etymology as proof.
genealogies.conceptual: Track the function even where vocabulary changes or disappears.
genealogies.problem: Track changes in the problem scene, opponents and phenomena that made the concept useful.

default.counter_genealogy: Construct an alternative history in which another distinction, practice or excluded case organizes the problem.
rivals: A strengthened version of the inherited position that accepts the local critique without abandoning its core explanandum.
An independent reconstruction that preserves the phenomenon using different relata and relation types.
default.positive_kernel: Preserve the motivating phenomenon while replacing universal necessity with a regional, contrast-sensitive and revisable relation profile.

formal_indication.name: Contrast-sensitive articulation
formal_indication.direction: Return to cases where rival descriptions diverge.
formal_indication.negation: Do not let one successful articulation become the measure of every region.
formal_indication.enactment: Vary access, scale and counterexample while tracking what remains explanatory.
formal_indication.limit: The indication opens inquiry and does not settle ontology.

default.surprise: The inherited concept may survive most powerfully not as an answer but as a device for producing a sharper question.
default.self_critique: Regionalization can protect the reconstruction from counterexamples by endlessly narrowing its domain.
default.mutation: Require each regional limit to be independently motivated and expose the reconstruction to a stronger rival partition.
default.destroyed: The inherited concept's claim to unqualified necessity.
default.preserved: The phenomenon and practical demand that made the concept philosophically productive.
default.open: Whether the reconstructed relation is a feature of the phenomenon or of the chosen access and vocabulary.
default.revision_trigger: Reopen when a contrast case defeats the discriminator or an independent source changes the reconstructed problem scene.
